value.rationale: The same natural maximal-ranked order-polytopes have been studied for combinatorial invariants but their uniform-volume covariance is a distinct geometric invariant. The classification identifies all least-variance directions across two parameters, the sharp integer jump at q=p-1 and a high-multiplicity degeneracy at q=p+3; neither is a mere renaming of an order-statistic identity. This yields the covariance condition number and identifies geometric anisotropy of ranked-order sampling.
